samples.text: Hello there. I was hoping you could help me out with a couple of questions I have about your services. I've been trying to reach someone all morning.
This is actually my first time bringing my vehicle to Sewell. A friend of mine recommended you guys because he said the customer service was fantastic.
I don't have an account with you guys yet, so I think we might need to set one up from scratch. I just bought the car used from a private seller last week.
Sure, my name is Sarah Connor. That's Sarah with an H, and Connor is C O N N O R. I should be in your system from about three years ago.
I'm calling about my account, but it's actually under my husband's name. It's under Michael Scott, and the phone number on file should be his cell.
Actually, I recently moved across the state, so my preferred location is Dallas now instead of Austin. Could you go ahead and update that on my profile?
I really need to schedule a synthetic oil change and a tire rotation for my twenty twenty two Lexus RX. It just hit thirty thousand miles yesterday.
I'd like to book some routine maintenance for my Ford. It's been making this really weird squeaking noise every time I apply the brakes going downhill.
The vehicle in question is a two thousand sixteen diesel model. It's an F two fifty super duty, and it takes about thirteen quarts of oil.
I was thinking I'll bring it in this Friday at ten AM. If that time is completely booked up, I can probably do Thursday afternoon around three instead.
Yes, I will definitely need a loaner vehicle. My wife took our other car out of town for the weekend, so I have absolutely no other way to get to the office.
Actually, if it's only going to take an hour or two, I'll just wait at the dealership. I brought my laptop so I can just catch up on some emails in the lounge.
Something just came up at work, so can we change my appointment to two PM? My morning meeting got pushed back and now I have a massive conflict.
I'm going to have to push my service back to next Tuesday. My kids got sick and I can't leave the house today. Does next Tuesday morning work for you guys?
Do you guys happen to have a collision center on site? I was rear-ended at a stoplight yesterday and the bumper is completely dented in.
I was looking online and couldn't find the answer to this, but what exactly is your policy on parts warranties? Do they cover labor costs if the part fails prematurely?
Can you tell me a little bit more about the Sewell difference? I hear the commercials on the radio all the time but I'm not really sure what makes it so special.
Where exactly are you guys located? I know you have a few different branches around the city, but I'm looking for the one closest to the downtown area.
Listen, I've been talking to this robot for five minutes and I just want to speak to a real person. Can you please transfer me to a human representative?
No, I think that just about covers everything I needed to know. That's all for today. Thanks so much for all your help, I really appreciate it.
